tasks.title: Helping at the School Open Day
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your classmate, Ben, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Open Day helpers
paragraphs: Hi! Thanks for saying you'll help at the school Open Day next Saturday. There are three roles we need to fill: welcoming visitors at the entrance, helping in the sports hall, or showing people around the science labs. Which one would you like to do?
Also, what time can you start? The event runs from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., but we can do half-day shifts.
Do you have any ideas for a fun activity we could organise for visiting families?
Let me know if you need any equipment for your role. I'll try to get it ready.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for Ben's email
listItems: Choose a role and say why you chose it.
Tell Ben what time you can start.
Suggest one fun activity for families.
Ask Ben for one piece of equipment you need.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Ben using all the notes.

tasks.title: Learning a Practical Skill
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: What practical skill have you learned that helps you in everyday life?
How did you learn it – from a family member, a friend, or by yourself?
When do you use this skill, and why is it useful?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our school blog!
